anomalies.description: Multi-Entity Corporate Name Succession: Municipal sanctions originated under M/S Jawala Real Estate Pvt. Ltd., were amended to M/s Lodha Developers Ltd., and culminated under Macrotech Developers Ltd. (CIN: U45200MH1995PLC093041).
documents_involved: 20210921 Kiara 7th to 42nd and Parkside full OC 64th.pdf
anomalies.significance: All entities represent successive legal corporate manifestations of the Lodha Group operating under file EB/1342/GS/A and MahaRERA P51900001339.

anomalies.description: Integrated Public Parking Lot (PPL / GCP) with Captive Private Parking: Development incorporates a massive 4,328-car municipal Public Parking Lot across Basements 1 to 3 and Podiums 1 to 2 in addition to 6,775 captive private resident car parking bays.
anomalies.significance: Permitted FSI incentive under Mumbai Mill Redevelopment DCR 33(24) which enabled the sanctioned construction of 271,636.86 sq.m gross BUA.

anomalies.description: Phased Vertical Occupancy Progression across 12 Part OCCs: Occupancy certificates were released in distinct height and wing tranches between May 2019 and February 2022 (e.g., floors 7-42, 43-62, 63-77, and specific penthouse/refuge units).
documents_involved: 0190613 MTM OC Wing 1,2,3- from 43rd to 62nd fl.pdf
20210921 Kiara 7th to 42nd and Parkside full OC 64th.pdf
20211215 OC Kiara (43 to 58 pt and 59 to 66).pdf
anomalies.significance: Demonstrates progressive commissioning of supertall towers while upper construction and mechanical installations completed.

anomalies.description: Multi-Source Extraction vs. Layout OCR Model Synthesis: Reconciliation of comprehensive 70-document portfolio data (2,201 RERA units, 12 Part OCCs, 21 cross-section elevation anchors) with direct 51-sheet layout CAD OCR model findings.
anomalies.significance: Resolved minor OCR misreadings (e.g., Ward 'L' reconciled to statutory G/South Ward 'GS'; 5.55m podium level reconciled with ±0.000m ground datum) while preserving 100% of OCR verbatim strings.
